| FINDING-03 | 🟡 Important | `vgv/unhandled-rejection` | `src/payments.js:3` | getTotal has no error handling around the fetch |
| FINDING-04 | 🔵 Suggestion | `simplicity/inline-single-use` | `src/utils/currency.js:5` | toDisplayPrice only forwards to formatCents |
